name: Honda VT1300 (Fury, Stateline, Sabre, Interstate)
engine: 1312 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Honda's 1300 cruisers. Some 2014-2015 bikes have a starter relay recall, and a few Furies a fuel tank weld recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014-2015 VT1300 bikes are in recall 15V439 (starter relay). A few 2010, 2016 and 2017 Furies are in recall 17V805 (fuel tank bracket welds missing).
A-002.reason: A fuel leak is a fire risk. Both fixes are free.

recalls.what: Starter relay switch can fail, so the bike may not start, or the starter may keep running.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the starter relay free.

recalls.what: Fuel tank may be missing welds at the mounting bracket, so the bracket can separate and fuel can leak.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects the welds and replaces the tank if needed, free.
